requirements_source.document: No separate requirements document was supplied
requirements_source.access: Scope taken from the project's README.md (document change monitoring). The README also records which documents came from the shared Drive folder (read-only) and which are mock test revisions.

repository.import_method: Uploaded folder. No version-control history and no original snapshot, so code changes cannot be compared with a baseline.
repository.framework: Python standard library only: http.server JSON API with a single static dashboard page (monitor/static/index.html).
repository.backend: Python 3.9+; SQLite history database (HISTORY_DB); difflib-based comparison (monitor/differ.py); rule-based analyzer (monitor/analyzer.py).
repository.routes: Dashboard at /; JSON API served by monitor/server.py; CLI via python -m monitor.cli (list, compare, scan).

requirements.text: Compare two versions of a document and list what changed, where (section and line numbers), with before and after text.
requirements.result: Stated in README: exact text comparison in monitor/differ.py.

requirements.text: Keep verified facts (exact text comparison) clearly separate from AI-style interpretation (requirement impact), which is labelled unverified.
requirements.result: Stated in README; the dashboard uses green for verified facts and purple for interpretation.

requirements.text: Flag changes that may affect software requirements (severity, categories, reasons) using rules: shall/should, numeric thresholds, deprecations, endpoint paths, requirement IDs.
requirements.result: Stated in README as heuristics; the README says heuristics can miss or over-flag.

requirements.text: Scan all documents and keep a reviewable history in a SQLite file.
requirements.result: Stated in README; history is stored only in the app's own history.db.

requirements.text: Drive access is read-only and mock files are not changed by a scan.
requirements.result: Stated in README. Tests assert no create, update or delete calls and that mock files are byte-identical after a scan.

requirements.text: Real Drive documents and invented mock revisions are labelled differently in the dashboard.
requirements.result: Stated in README; mock revisions carry a MOCK flag.
